episode_title: AI, Pre-IPO Investing, and What’s Next for Wealth Management

real_qa.q: What is Destiny Access and what gap in the private investment market does it fill?
real_qa.r: Destiny Access is an intelligence-rich destination portal built exclusively for qualified purchasers to consolidate private market opportunities, proprietary insights, and curated investment intelligence in one place. It addresses the gap in market coordination by allowing clients to pull up information about their holdings, see purchase prices and current valuations, and receive publicly available information live as it comes through AI-powered feeds, with tiles set up for individual holdings like Anthropic, Crusoe, SpaceX, and OpenAI.

real_qa.q: What is the mini-Tom agent feature in Destiny Intelligence and how is it being used?
real_qa.r: The mini-Tom agent is an AI feature built by integrating 35 years of Tom Ruggie's information including interviews, podcasts, and articles, supplemented by 40 additional questions answered in six hours of interviews. It helps Tom's 30-person team answer questions before they reach him by providing recommendations on what Tom would say about a topic, and it has unexpectedly provided significant time savings by giving him photographic memory to retrieve and modify previously answered questions within seconds.

real_qa.q: Why does Tom Ruggie believe an AI investment bubble will occur similar to the dot-com era?
real_qa.r: Tom anticipates that when major AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI hit the public market, there will be a feeding frenzy driven by fear of missing out and euphoric optimism, creating a bubble similar to the internet boom. While he believes the biggest AI companies like the future Microsoft, Apple, and Amazon will survive and thrive, he expects a day of reckoning where many other AI companies will become less attractive, though he notes the private investment pipeline is already becoming less robust than a year ago.
real_qa.requete: AI investment bubble dot-com era comparison

real_qa.q: What are the two main ways AI has provided time savings for Tom Ruggie's business?
real_qa.r: The first time savings is literal—AI gives him more hours in the day. The second and possibly more important is enabling him to do things he would not have had time for otherwise, such as significantly more vetting of direct investment and private company opportunities than previously possible, which ultimately benefits his clients.
real_qa.requete: AI time savings wealth management vetting

real_qa.q: What percentage of RIAs does Tom Ruggie estimate are truly utilizing AI to meaningful capacity?
real_qa.r: Tom estimates that less than 10% of RIAs are truly using AI to the capacity that will have a meaningful benefit to their business, despite the fact that if polled, 90% of financial advisors would claim they are utilizing AI. He emphasizes that the difference between simply utilizing AI and really capitalizing on it is significantly different.
real_qa.requete: RIAs using AI meaningful benefit percentage

Recently, he created Destiny Intelligence, an AI innovation company, after being inspired by a client's successful AI implementation and hiring a former Amazon AI innovation leader to head the platform.
